designs.name: SERV
designs.upstream_size: Artix-7: about 125 LUT and 164 FF; architecture-dependent
designs.notes: Best fast regression after the eight-cell fixture. The external-register-file synthesis wrapper can isolate LUT/FF placement before RAM support.

designs.name: PicoRV32
designs.notes: Single-file RTL and an upstream xcvu3p implementation result make this the preferred Phase 2 growth target. Requires a larger ArchitectureDB window and either LUTRAM/carry support or a logic-only synthesis policy.

designs.name: secworks AES
designs.notes: Mature iterative AES-128/256 core. Good density and routing stress test once the architecture window grows beyond the current 512 LUT/FF slots.

designs.name: Ibex
designs.upstream_size: Yosys ASIC estimates: 16.85-66.02 kGE depending on configuration
designs.notes: Production-quality CPU with packages, parameters, primitive dependencies and memories. Use after the SystemVerilog/FuseSoC frontend and macro handling are stable.

designs.name: VTR classic Verilog benchmarks
designs.notes: Useful flattened CAD benchmarks. Review per-benchmark provenance and exclude latch/multiclock cases from the initial single-clock semantic envelope.

designs.name: Koios 2.0 deep-learning benchmarks
designs.upstream_size: 40 medium and large DL/CAD designs; variants include small, medium, and large source files
designs.notes: Primary large open-RTL suite. Start with gemm_layer and attention_layer in soft-logic mode, then enable inferred BRAM/DSP, and finally use dla_like.medium/large and tpu_like.large variants. Each source file is compiled separately because several files intentionally reuse module names such as top and DLA.

designs.name: VeeR EH1
designs.upstream_size: Real dual-issue RV32IMC CPU with instruction/data tightly coupled memories, instruction cache, branch prediction, debug, interrupt, and AXI/AHB interfaces
designs.notes: A genuine connected application design rather than a replicated-core harness. Upstream provides an FPGA-optimized configuration and a Vivado synthesis target. First screen the pinned veer_wrapper with Vivado, then bridge the generated primitive netlist into EmuIR only if the mapped scale meets the experiment gate.

designs.name: NVDLA nvdlav1
designs.license: NVIDIA Open NVDLA License and Agreement v1.0
designs.upstream_size: Full-precision nvdlav1 implements 2048 8-bit MACs or 1024 16-bit MACs, plus memories and control
designs.notes: Final frontend, hierarchy, memory, partition-capacity, and runtime stress test. NV_nvdla is the genuine connected top over the five upstream synthesis partitions. The shared frontend offers an explicitly labeled black-box SRAM scale screen and a separate fail-closed inferred-block-RAM model covering every pinned rws/rwsp/rwst/rwsthp wrapper for physical holdout validation; proprietary ASIC DFT logic is never expanded into LUTs. The nvdlav1 branch is deliberately pinned and its custom license must be preserved.
